# CROSS_LESSONS

Auto-generated by `fleet lessons-sync`. Do not edit by hand —
your edits will be overwritten on the next sync. The source of
truth is each project's `docs/LESSONS.md`.

## agent-fleet

### 2026-05-26 — test wrote to a non-isolated path

Symptom: a shell test wrote to `$HOME/.cache` and bled state into the
next run. Cause: the test did not create its own `mktemp -d` sandbox.
Fix: every test owns its own filesystem, isolated via `mktemp -d` and
`export HOME="$TMP/home"`. shell-only kit, no runtime deps.

### 2026-06-01 — printf consumed flag arg as option

Symptom: `printf '%s' "$flag"` on a flag value starting with `-`
fails with "invalid option". Cause: printf parses the FIRST positional
arg for option flags. Fix: prefix with the POSIX `--` end-of-options
marker, e.g. `printf -- '%s' "$flag"`.

### 2026-06-08 — IFS=$'\t' read shifts left on empty middle field

Symptom: `IFS=$'\t' read -r a b c d` collapses adjacent delimiters
when IFS is non-whitespace. Empty middle fields disappear and the
columns shift left. Fix: emit a sentinel string in the optional
column from awk and map it back to empty in the dispatcher.
